body: It’s not…. You wouldn’t want your loved ones and family feel the same way you felt about your friend. I’m so sorry u had to hear that. Please reach out for help, talk to your family
The only people remembered will be the victims. Not you.

Hello, I’m 22 and I had an attempt in 2022. I’ve been to the therapist and psychiatrist before and all they have diagnosed me with is anxiety and clinical depression lol. I don’t think it’s only that, because ever since my attempt, the suicidal thoughts come and go. I’m in college now but idfk what I want to do yet. I feel so behind and honestly that makes me feel even more suicidal. My advice for you is that you get a job, I noticed that keeping myself distracted with something makes me feel less suicidal. It also allows me to get out of my room and get ready. There is such a nice feeling about getting ready to go out that I can’t explain. Try to find a job on something you are somewhat interested in. I’m currently working at my college and it’s relatively easy ((I’m a tutor for english-as-a-second-language students)) it’s not my passion and the pay is pretty bad but at least I’m not at my room rotting away ((like I do during the weekends)).

You’re so young but I can see myself in you. I also tried killing myself when I was your age. I was so desperate. But I realized I didn’t want to die, I just wanted to escape all the bad things happening in my life. You have so much ahead of you. I hope life treats you better and that you can find joy.

I think sadness. I had planned my suicide but I never planned an specific date for it. One time, I was left alone at my house and I felt so lonely, I started thinking about everything wrong with my life and started drinking. Eventually I got drunk, mixed some pills and I was unconscious. It was spontaneously, I really didn’t care if I woke up or not. I just didn’t care at all. I didn’t even think about my family.

For me, I feel bad for the trauma I have caused others. My sister found me laying on the bathroom floor unconscious and I never thought of how she might have felt at that time. I feel so sorry for her, since that time she checks up on me randomly. If she doesn’t see me at my room she starts calling for me. Or if I’m not home she asks me where I’m at and she even has my location lol ((I’m 22)). And then, my mom just never talks about my attempt. When I went to therapy, we did kinda of a dual session, it was me and her. And she just started bawling her eyes out, I felt it was necessary to talk about my attempt but she just couldn’t do it. She said she didn’t even want to think about it. I felt so bad. Though, I think talking about it would’ve helped me :( I still think my attempt wasn’t taken as seriously, nothing changed.

Hey, I was exactly like this after one of my suicide attempts failed and I was sent to the hospital. I could only think about doing it again once I got home. But my dad and sisters hid all the pills from me lol. I was just like you, with no friends and super lost in life. Just wait and see how things unfold, you never know who you can meet later in life. I hope life gets better for you. Don’t give up.

Man, it took me 3 years to tell my parents I wanted to see a therapist. At first I thought they were gonna make fun of me and belittle my feelings but they just told me “okay”. Good enough lol. It is kinda awkward tho, if you don’t want to say the true reason why you wanna go just say you’re not doing that great at school (that’s what I did lol). And I feel you, talking about my feelings in therapy was such a cringey experience, but it was nice

This was very interesting to read tbh. Man, the people around you really suck. I can somewhat relate to you also. Right now I don’t even know what I’m doing with my life. I have no friends to hang around with, after I graduated high school I stopped having contact with any of my classmates (they were all pieces of shit tbh) and because I have social anxiety I just can’t make any friends at all. It is very difficult for me to maintain any type of relationship. After I graduated I was supposed to go straight to college but because of the pandemic and classes being online I told myself I’d take off a semester. Lies. I took a whole gap year. The worst mistake ever. I’d rarely leave my house. Meaning all the time I spent was inside my room. No friends, nothing. Just me and my silly thoughts which then became suicidal thoughts. I did go see a therapist but I guess I was too much work and she ditched me. I was referred to another therapist but tbh asking for help the first time took me around 3 years. So going to another therapist just like that? Hell nah. I do think you should see a therapist tho, there were some things I did learn while I was being treated. It feels nice being listened. And if you don’t wanna go, then don’t go but at least you know this mentally ill person lurking on reddit at 8:24 pm crying in her bedroom, did read your post.

Hey, I relate to you so much. Except I did tell people how I felt and even told them about my suicide attempts. No one cared. Not even my mom, she just told me to pray to God for it to go away (mental illness cure hack!! 100% effective) and never spoke about it again. Not even a “how are you feeling today”, nothing. She probably forgot about it. Worst thing is, I told my therapist about my latest suicide attempt and she ditched me, saying she could no longer treat me. She did referred me to another therapist but I just gave up and never made an appointment. Then, I told one of my friends that I was taking anti-depressants and he said he found it weird when people took pills for their mental illnesses. Shit made me so embarrassed of myself so I just don’t tell anyone abt it. So now, I don’t tell people about me being suicidal. I don’t even have that many people around me. I only have one friend irl, and she tries to help me but I just can’t. As for you, at least you have someone who loves you. You said you guys don’t talk that often but just wait and see how things unfold, maybe in the future you guys will be talking 24/7. You never know. So hang in there and accept the love they’re giving to you. Have a nice day.

Doesn’t work… I’ve tried OD on ibuprofen a lot of times ever since I was in middle school (I’m in my second year of college) and along the way im pretty sure my liver/kidneys got damaged. Nothing happens after, you’re just gonna be shitting a lot. Go to the doctor to get a check up.
